text:
Sam (PM): Quick sync — we need a single checklist for prod entry focused on customer-driven asks. Main buckets: SLA targets, docs + onboarding, support coverage, monitoring/telemetry, and pricing gating. Can we list blockers and owners by EOD Friday?
Priya (Eng): From eng: runtime and fallback policies are implemented. Open item: confirm SLA targets with SRE and product (latency p95, availability). Also need canary config for Dedicated.
Luis (SRE): TL;DR: p95 latency goal = 200ms for hosted small models, 500ms for heavy gen; availability target = 99.95%. Need smoke dashboards + alert runbook. Missing: synthetic canary that covers KV cache warm paths.
Sam (PM): Noted. Luis — can you own synthetic canary and smoke dashboards? ETA Thu noon?
Luis (SRE): I can take it. Thu 12:00 works if eng provides canary tokens + model variant list by Wed EOD.
Priya (Eng): Will provide model list + token generator by Wed EOD. Also canary route requires batching disabled — adding config PR today.
Jenny (Docs): Docs check: we need onboarding guide, quickstart for Dedicated and Private, and an SLA FAQ (customer-facing). I can draft the quickstart and SLA FAQ if I get the final SLA numbers and the failure/fallback behavior descriptions.
Sam (PM): Jenny — SLA numbers will be 99.95%/p95 200ms for hosted small as Luis suggested. We still need commercial exception list for enterprise customers (Marco to confirm).
Marco (FinOps): Confirming: baseline pricing gating requires cost-per-token estimate for the three profile tiers (small/medium/large). I need perf numbers + batch amplification estimates from Eng to finish pricing. Target: pricing proposal by Fri COB.
Amber (Support): Support coverage: next-week rotation already light. For GA we need a 24/7 oncall playbook for first 30 days and a faster escalation path to Eng. I can draft the playbook if oncall rota is locked.
Sam (PM): Amber — can you draft playbook by Thu EOD? We'll lock rota after we finalize the oncall names (ops + eng).
Priya (Eng): Also: feature flag for automatic fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained — spec in #eng-runtime but will post short summary here. Owner: Priya. ETA Wed.
Luis (SRE): Alerts to create: 1) Canary failure 2) Error rate > 0.5% for 5m 3) Latency p95 breach for two consecutive 1m windows. Add an automated rollback play (deploy-bot can trigger).
deploy-bot: automated message: New canary pipeline integrated: canary-runner/v2 deployed to staging at 1778870000.
Sam (PM): Good. Also need acceptance criteria for docs: quickstart + troubleshooting + SLA FAQ must be reviewer-approved (docs + PM) before GA. Jenny add reviewers please.
Jenny (Docs): Reviewers: Sam, Priya, Amber. Will ping for reviews. Draft by Thu noon.
Marco (FinOps): For pricing I need a simple cost model: tokens/sec * unit-cost GPU + infra overhead. Priya — can you give me token throughput for small/medium/large models under realistic batch sizes?
Priya (Eng): Will run throughput test matrix (batch sizes 1,8,32) and post numbers by Wed EOD.
Amber (Support): One more ask from support: a short customer-facing incident template (what we tell customers on degraded perf). I can draft; needs legal + PM sign-off.
Sam (PM): OK — action summary: Luis: canary + dashboards (Thu 12:00). Priya: model list + canary config + perf matrix (Wed EOD). Jenny: docs drafts (Thu noon). Marco: pricing proposal (Fri COB). Amber: oncall playbook + customer incident template (Thu EOD). I'll collate checklist and propose a trimmed GA exit checklist for leadership on Friday morning.
Priya (Eng): Quick question — are we locking SLA numbers now or can we mark them provisional for GA1?
Sam (PM): Provisional OK but must be communicated. Any customer-facing SLA must be final by GA launch. For GA1 we can mark a "declared" SLA with known caveats (we'll include that in the FAQ).
Luis (SRE): One risk: quantized model regressions can affect latency consistency. Mitigation: model-shop backups + automatic variant routing. We'll include that in the runbook.
Sam (PM): Thanks — last ask: if any blocker pops up, escalate to me + @Marco. I'll run a 15-min triage each morning until GA.
Amber (Support): Copy that. I'll set up a recurring 09:00 slot starting Thu.
Jenny (Docs): I'll ping reviewers when drafts are up.
Sam (PM): Thanks team — I'll push this into the GA readiness board and tag owners. :thumbsup:
